name: feature.evals.nodes
description: Agent eval node pack (ADR 0889 WF-EV-11) over the `ctx.features.evals` surface. `run-suite` starts an RFC 0081 eval run of a suite against an agent, waits for it to finish, and outputs the scorecard plus one gate boolean (`ok` = passed and not regressed), so a chain can branch on a regression inside the app instead of only in the CLI. role:"side-effect": the run spends model calls, so a replay fork is served the recorded outcome and never starts a second eval run. It cancels its eval run when the workflow run is cancelled or its wait times out. v1.1.0: it passes its nodeId, and the surface starts the eval run once per (workflow run, node), so a re-dispatched node gets the same eval run back. Needs a signed-in person behind the run and the `evals` feature.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Agent Evals: Run Suite
nodes.description: Runs an agent eval suite (RFC 0081 / RFC 0244) via ctx.features.evals and waits for the scorecard. Inputs: { suiteRef, agentId, baselineRunId?, timeoutMs? }. Output: { evalRunId, status, passed, regressed, ok, aggregateScore, passedCount, taskCount, verdict }. A refused start, an eval run that ends failed or cancelled, and a wait that times out are typed failures, never a pass.
